ledger_decisions.hypothesis: The original gateway proves fleet and hot-database scale.
A fixed prewarmed pool per repository database is acceptable at fleet scale.
Increasing same-database writers continues to improve throughput materially.
Repository-per-database partitioning provides useful concurrency.
A hot ae database on a shared Dolt process does not materially affect cold repositories.
Dolt commits alone prevent same-value lost updates.
Independent snapshot prevalidation preserves graph acyclicity under parallel writers.
Concurrent same-principal claim delivery is naturally idempotent.
Conflicting distinct-principal claims silently create multiple winners.
Hundreds of tiny databases have negligible idle process cost.
Naive multiwriter gateway can be promoted after the fleet run.
The gateway direct domain/UOW path preserves canonical Beads claim, lease, row_lock, close, and conflict-retry semantics.
A typed Dolt serialization failure can be recovered by replaying the complete operation in a fresh unit of work.
The gateway can be bootstrapped without granting a fleet-wide or production-capable database identity.
An exact client retry duplicates a successful gateway mutation.
A process crash after Dolt commit but before queue/HTTP success causes blind replay or lost success.
A process crash after durable queue lease but before Dolt execution loses or duplicates the command.
The first 120-second busy-profile run is sufficient fleet-capacity proof.
A terminal success acknowledged with HTTP 200 is lost or duplicated after complete loss of the local SQLite projection.
The corrected realistic busy run cannot sustain the frozen AI-paced load at 150 ms RTT with exact cross-database effects.
A coordinated high human/agent burst overwhelms the dedicated database lanes or violates correctness at 150 ms RTT.
The terminal-first prototype is already leak-proof and fleet-promotable after successful projection-loss recovery.
A fleet cell needs one fixed warm pool per repository or will miss practical latency under pool churn.
F19 and F20 constitute full fleet-capacity promotion evidence.
Two gateway peers can turn ambiguous retries into duplicate or conflicting terminal outcomes.
A terminal HTTP 200 can survive acknowledged Dolt replication, primary loss, promotion, and empty gateway projection.
Signed routing, bounded fair scheduling, and lazy pools are already an integrated fleet cell.
A 100-database cell requires unbounded connections to sustain adversarial churn.
Dolt SELECT FOR UPDATE is sufficient to bound concurrent producer and receipt admission.
A smaller Go memory limit or disabled Dolt auto-GC is the primary fleet fix.
The Beads proxied mutation kernel can safely retry a conflicted commit on the same UOW.
A small direct-SQL patch can meet the distributed-team workload without a near-data service.
The authoritative real-Dolt retention proof can mutate any loopback Dolt server that happens to expose the expected database.
A checksum bundle alone proves that the executed c26c8325 binary came from the recorded source tree.
The broad gateway laboratory can be published as one merge-ready or upstream-ready change.
Completed lab compute can remain running without affecting the final safety verdict.
The operator fork's stale main branch is a truthful review base for the UOW safety Draft.
